activities.title: Validate Host Model
activities.description: 檢查 center_part.name + peripherals 非空 + 每 peripheral name/side（enum top|bottom|left|right）齊全，缺項或非法 side fail-fast

activities.title: Resolve Peripheral Glyphs
activities.description: 周邊型別對樣式庫；未覆蓋者轉具名 placeholder（dashed 邊框，不靜默省略）

activities.title: Lay Out Center And Radial Peripherals
activities.description: 確定性放射狀版面：center 置中、peripherals 依 side 分組、組內依宣告序排列；無 RNG

activities.title: Draw Buses From Center
activities.description: 從 center 邊緣正交連線到各 peripheral + bus 標籤 + 圖例層

activities.title: Stamp Honest Boundary Annotations
activities.description: 自動寫 functional block diagram not a netlist / no RefDes.Pin to net / no DRC-SI claim；常開不可參數化；有 reference_baseline 則加渲染 derived-from + diffs + sourcing gates

activities.title: Emit Layered Vector And Raster
activities.description: 寫分層 SVG；cairosvg 在則出 PNG，缺則標 unavailable 不列 files

activities.title: Orchestrate Editable Slide Export
activities.description: 選配：經 mcp_call 驅動 docxmcp 產原生可編輯 PPTX shape；不可達標 unavailable 不偽造
